question: Can the existing single-product pass_fused idea be applied to conv_sum_otf without moving inverse transforms inside the term loop or adding an unpriced storage/recompute path?
number: conv_sum_otf generates and forward-transforms tmpA/tmpB for each term, multiplies and accumulates into frequency-domain row, then runs one inverse-pass loop after the term loop. A direct pass_fused substitution would repeat inverse passes per term; no existing sum-fused kernel is present.
